Speech & AI settings

Hosted transcription uses our free Hugging Face Space with Shook for Amharic and Whisper Small English for English. Audio is sent there only when you choose Transcribe. Free queues and daily limits apply. Automatic translation is not connected; you can type a translation yourself.

Advanced: enter your own Python backend below to use local transcription and Ollama translation. Leave the address empty to use the hosted speech service.

Recordings and stories are saved in this browser. When using a custom backend, Transcribe or Translate sends the relevant audio or text to that backend. Hosted transcription sends audio to Hugging Face, where processing files are temporary. Your browser may request permission to connect to a local service.

Download the local app & source
Running the backend

The project includes a Python backend, requirements, a Dockerfile, and a setup guide. Run ./start.sh from the source checkout, then connect to http://localhost:8000. For the fully local experience, open that address directly. A hosted preview needs a reachable backend for AI features.

Every voice has a history.

Record a parent or grandparent’s memories in Amharic or English, review the transcript, and turn their words into a picture storybook.

Add your own family photos or illustrations and captions to the cover and pages. Automatic AI illustrations are not connected yet. You can add a translation yourself; automatic translation is not available in the hosted app.

Download digital book: an HTML storybook with your pictures, text, and original voice recording embedded. Open it in a browser to read and listen offline.

Print / Save PDF: a printable storybook with your pictures, captions, and text. PDF files do not include playable audio.

Download keepsake: a simpler HTML copy with the original recording, transcript, and any translation. There is no separate audio-only download button yet.

Your saved memories and storybooks stay in this browser on this device. They do not sync between devices. Download a digital book or keepsake to back up the original voice. Pictures are resized in your browser.

When you choose Transcribe, audio is sent to our Hugging Face Space running Shook Tiny Amharic or Whisper Small English. Free queues and usage limits apply. Listen and review names, dates, and meaning before sharing.

The written example is fictional and its Amharic translation is illustrative. Your recordings preserve the original voice.
